name: pl-dyanon
title: A dynamic anonymization ChRIS plugin
description: A ChRIS plugin to dynamically anonymize DICOMs in bulk

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.help:
pattern for file names to include.
            Default is **/*csv.

parameters.name: pluginInstanceID
parameters.help: plugin instance ID from which to start analysis

parameters.name: CUBEurl
parameters.help: CUBE URL. Please include api version in the url endpoint.

parameters.name: CUBEtoken
parameters.help: CUBE/ChRIS user token

parameters.name: maxThreads
parameters.help: max number of parallel threads

parameters.name: orthancUrl
parameters.help: Orthanc server url. Please include api version in the url endpoint.

parameters.name: orthancUsername
parameters.help: Orthanc server username

parameters.name: orthancPassword
parameters.help: Orthanc server password

parameters.name: pushToRemote
parameters.help: Remote modality

parameters.name: thread
parameters.help: use threading to branch in parallel

parameters.name: wait
parameters.help: wait for nodes to reach finished state

parameters.name: PFDCMurl
parameters.help: endpoint URL of pfdcm. Please include api version in the url endpoint.

parameters.name: PACSname
parameters.help: name of the PACS

parameters.name: recipients
parameters.help: comma separated valid email recipient addresses

parameters.name: SMTPServer
parameters.help: valid email server

parameters.name: preserveTags
parameters.help: A stringified JSON of header tags from the original DICOM to keep

parameters.name: dicomFilter
parameters.help: comma separated dicom tags with values

parameters.name: imgCount
parameters.help: comma separated image count filter expression.

parameters.name: pipelineName
parameters.default: PACS query, retrieve, and registration verification in CUBE 20241217
parameters.help: Name of the pipeline to run in the analysis

parameters.name: reducePipelineName
parameters.help: Name of the pipeline to run on the collected results

parameters.name: reduceFilter
parameters.help: Filter the output on file type before joining
